The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1) visit the Houston Rockets (5-1) in the Thunder's sixth game of the season. Oklahoma City is 3-0 at home, 1-1 on the road, second in the Northwest and fourth in the West, and it enters on a one-game losing streak after a 4-1 last ten. The Rockets are second in the West and half a game back in the Southwest, with a 5-1 last ten and a one-game losing streak of their own.

The Thunder are missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Houston is without Fred VanVleet (knee), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain).

The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 2-1. The last meeting was a 112-106 Thunder loss in Oklahoma City on February 7, 2026.
